headline: Supreme Court Forms Five-Member Committee To Investigate Why My Local Tea Stall Ran Out Of Extra-Strong Ginger
body:
"I just wanted a piping hot cup of tea before my 9 AM shift, but now I have to wait for the committee to submit their interim findings on the root cause of the ginger shortage," said a local office commuter.

"The chairman arrived in a black SUV to cross-examine my spice supplier, and now my shop is officially a crime scene until they finish the forensic analysis of the tea leaves," remarked the shopkeeper.

"I missed my lecture because the court-appointed experts had cordoned off the entire lane to take depositions from the stray cat that sleeps near the ginger basket," added a confused college student.

"Honestly, as long as the committee files their report before the monsoon begins, I think we might actually get a ginger-infused brew by next year," observed a neighborhood resident.

"I’ve been asked to provide a sworn affidavit explaining exactly when I first noticed the ginger-less state of my beverage, but I’m still waiting for a stamp paper in triplicate," shared a disgruntled regular customer.
caption: The judicial system is finally tackling the issues that truly impact the nation: the sudden disappearance of ginger from our morning tea. #JusticeForChai #GingerProbe #Judiciary #Priorities (satire)
igHook: Would you testify before a Supreme Court committee for a cup of ginger tea?
imagePrompt: A close-up shot of a rustic roadside tea stall counter with empty metal containers and a small, official-looking document taped to the side, surrounded by a blurry urban street scene.
